title: VB8
script:
-- سكربت VB8 - الأسطورة عبود 😎
-- واجهة عربية + دعم للجوال + أغنية طفولية

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local FlyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local SkinButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local DestroyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local MusicButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

-- إعدادات الواجهة
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "VB8Script"

Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 350)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -175)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true

Title.Parent = Frame
Title.Text = "سكربت VB8 - الأسطورة عبود"
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
Title.TextScaled = true

-- زر الطيران
FlyButton.Parent = Frame
FlyButton.Text = "🛫 طيران"
FlyButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
FlyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
FlyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
FlyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlyButton.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
FlyButton.TextScaled = true
FlyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/YOUR_FLY_SCRIPT"))()
end)

-- زر نسخ السكن
SkinButton.Parent = Frame
SkinButton.Text = "👕 نسخ السكن"
SkinButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
SkinButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 100)
SkinButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
SkinButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SkinButton.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
SkinButton.TextScaled = true
SkinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/YOUR_SKIN_SCRIPT"))()
end)

-- زر التخريب
DestroyButton.Parent = Frame
DestroyButton.Text = "💣 تخريب"
DestroyButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
DestroyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 150)
DestroyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
DestroyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DestroyButton.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
DestroyButton.TextScaled = true
DestroyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/YOUR_DESTROY_SCRIPT"))()
end)

-- زر تشغيل الأغنية
MusicButton.Parent = Frame
MusicButton.Text = "🎵 تشغيل Baby Shark"
MusicButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
MusicButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 200)
MusicButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
MusicButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MusicButton.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
MusicButton.TextScaled = true

Sound.Parent = Frame
Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://614018503"
Sound.Volume = 1

MusicButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Sound:Play()
end)
